研究摘记: 第二次购买；自述前一套使用6个月，没有起球，换色复购。
评论原文: This is my 2nd purchase of these sheets. I came back for another color for winter. The last set I bought 6 months ago has held up so well. No pilling! The sheets are so soft and the quality is excellent. The cooling feature is legitimate. I will be replacing all of the sheet sets in my house with these.

研究摘记: 厚床垫上不脱角、柔软透气；明确称因此购买第二套。
评论原文: These sheets are SO incredibly soft and cozy! One of our favorite things is that the fitted sheet actually stays on our thick Tempur-Pedic mattress without constantly popping off the corners! 🙌🏼 They’re lightweight, breathable, and keep us cool throughout the night without getting too hot. We loved them so much that we actually went back and ordered a SECOND set! 😂💜 We’ll officially be tossing out our old sheets and replacing them with these! That should tell you just how much we love them! Highly recommend!

研究摘记: 自述得州夏季夜间凉爽，柔软与售后体验均获肯定。
评论原文: These are by far the softest sheets I have owned. They feel silky smooth on my skin and kept me cool during the hot summer nights here in Texas. They were delivered ahead of schedule and the support team was extremely communicative about the status of the shipment and following up after the item was delivered to ensure satisfaction with their product. Very impressive and extremely happy with the entire experience.

研究摘记: 自述整夜凉爽舒适、轻盈透气；属于体验而非性能检测。
评论原文: I absolutely love these bamboo sheets! They are incredibly soft, silky smooth, and feel so luxurious against my skin. One of my favorite things about them is how cool and comfortable they keep me throughout the night. They're lightweight, breathable, and don't leave me feeling hot or overheated while sleeping. The quality is excellent, and they give my bed that luxurious, hotel-like feel. I'm extremely pleased with my purchase and would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for soft, comfortable, cooling sheets!

研究摘记: 自述多次洗涤后柔软、贴合且未明显变皱；持续使用时长未精确披露。
评论原文:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

These sheets are REALLY GOOD. We’ve had them long enough that I can confidently say they weren’t just nice straight out of the package—they’ve held up beautifully.

They’re soft and comfortable without feeling flimsy, wash well, and still feel great after repeated use. They fit the mattress properly, stay in place, and don’t turn into a wrinkled, tangled mess overnight. 😂

We’ve bought plenty of sheets over the years that felt great at first and then quickly lost their softness or quality. These have been different.

Comfortable. Good quality. Holding up well.

Definitely a set we would purchase again.

研究摘记: 明确表示因宣称凉感和温度调节而买；使用3天后表示更热。
评论原文: I purchased these bamboo sheets because they are “supposed to be cooling and temperature regulating”. I washed them first as recommended. Have been using them for 3 days now and very unhappy they have no cooling or temperature regulation to them. They actually keep me hotter. In comparison to performance cotton sheets. I am very in happy and will not be using very often in my rotation.

研究摘记: 明确表示因为凉感而购买，但体验与普通床单相近。
评论原文: The sheets are ok, not the most comfortable, but also not the least. However, they were bought because they were supposed to be cooling sheets and they are not. They're not any more "cooling" then a set of regular sheets you can get from Walmart. For the price, you can flip a coin whether to pick these up or go to a retail store.

研究摘记: 自称怕热，期待凉感；反馈不透气、粘身。
评论原文:
I was so excited to try and try these sheets! I am quite a warm sleeper, so I was looking forward to the “cooling” effect of these sheets. They fit ok, and stretch out like most sheets over a period of days. 

They’re trash. They feel like microfiber sheets. They are not at all breathable, or cooling. My husband feels like he sticks to them. I’m giving 2 stars because I really love the color.


Update 7/4/26
Changing my review to 1 star because the seller messaged me asking to change my review in exchange for a 5% discount.

研究摘记: 明确用于膝关节置换恢复期，称柔软。
评论原文: I love love love these sheets! They are so soft and comforting. I bought them for my bed to  recover from Knee replacement surgery and they did not disappoint. I will definitely buy more from this brand again.

It says bamboo sheets after I complained. I got an email showing that if you scroll down three pages, it says that there’s 60% 40%. Save your money they are garbage.

研究摘记: 同一消费者称蓝色柔软、后购深灰粗糙；4次洗涤仍未改善。
评论原文: I ordered the spa blue and it was soft so I ordered the dark Grey. The dark Grey set is rough and grainy, not soft at all. I washed them 4 times and still they are scratchy. These Sheets remind me of 200 grain, bottom of the barrel cheap sheets from the dollar store. I waisted 41.11 on sheets !!!!!

研究摘记: 同一消费者对比此前浅紫款与本次款，称手感不同；单条自述不能证明普遍批次问题。
评论原文: I have ordered these exact same sheets in the light purple and the texture and feel of them are not the same at all. For some reason, these are very scratchy compared to the light purple ones that I bought, which were very buttery soft. I even washed them to see if that would help and unfortunately it did not so I am disappointed.

研究摘记: 自称14英寸床垫仍脱角，并报告起球；同时认可柔软和颜色。
评论原文: I followed the directions and washed my sheets before use.  Pros: They are soft and comfortable to sleep in.  The color is beautiful.   Cons:  They are not made to fit deep mattresses..  I have a 14" mattress and these have popped off.  The mix of microfiber and bamboo is not great as the sheets are already pilling and not getting more satin like.  Microfiber is also nat making them as breathable as hoped.

研究摘记: 自述叠加褥垫后需每天拉回床角，但多次洗涤后状态良好。
评论原文: These are a really nice quality sheet set, and the color is beautiful. My only critique is that I wish the pockets were a little bit deeper. I have to tug on them daily to keep them from pulling up at the corners because I have a mattress topper. I have washed them several times and they are still in great shape.

研究摘记: 自述加4英寸记忆棉褥垫仍贴合良好，针脚质量受认可。
评论原文: These sheets came in very quickly, I thought the stitching would be cheap but no the stitching is actually very high quality and is good at keep the sheets on your bed. They have deep pockets and fit good on my bed that has a 4 inch memory foam topper on it. I would extremely recommend them!
